drug_class: Synthetic opioid agonist; analgesic and maintenance therapy agent

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer reduces methadone plasma concentrations, precipitating withdrawal symptoms and loss of therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. If patient requires herbal therapy, consider alternative agents and monitor for withdrawal symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases methadone metabolism and bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid co-administration; if TB treatment necessary, use alternative antitubercular agents or increase methadone dose under close monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Supplement
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases methadone levels, elevating risk of overdose, respiratory depression, and QT prolongation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid consumption; counsel patient on all grapefruit-containing products including juices and supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CNS depressant effects potentiated with methadone; hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use; counsel on risk of severe sedation and liver injury

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depressant effects may increase sedation and respiratory depression risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and respiratory depression; advise patient to limit use or avoid

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce methadone levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor methadone efficacy; short-term use likely safe but counsel on potential reduced pain control

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase methadone concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of methadone toxicity (drowsiness, constipation); use cautiously

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases methadone plasma concentrations and prolongs half-life, increasing overdose risk and QT prolongation
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; instruct patient to eliminate all grapefruit products from diet

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may modestly increase methadone bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Recommend avoidance or significant restriction; monitor for signs of methadone toxicity

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase methadone absorption and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to maintain consistent dietary fat intake; avoid large fluctuations to minimize methadone level variability

caution_foods.name: Foods High in Fiber (Excessive Amounts)
caution_foods.mechanism: May reduce methadone absorption; methadone already causes constipation
caution_foods.action: Moderate fiber intake; monitor for therapeutic efficacy changes and bowel function

monitoring_notes: Methadone has a narrow therapeutic window with high QT prolongation risk; monitor ECG periodically and assess for signs of toxicity (oversedation, respiratory depression, constipation). Screen for CYP450 interactions at initiation and with any medication changes, as many inducers/inhibitors significantly alter methadone levels and withdrawal/overdose risk.
